msg: You have a split second to decide what colour of gnome to select. You need to pay rapt attention to the colour combinations and try to remember what colour match between the gnome and baskets gives the highest number of mushrooms. The aim is to memorize the gnome colours with the highest mushroom harvest. You are presented with 8 colours; red, pink, brown, purple, yellow, orange, blue and green gnomes. You also have baskets of red, yellow and orange baskets. When a basket is producing more mushrooms, it is better to stick to that colour, please note that this can change at any time but you just need to memorize the flow and be able to predict the best colour match of gnome and basket. Tip: the colour combination of gnome and basket that gives the highest mushrooms changes after each breaks in the game so you will need to relearn the new high mushroom producing baskets. Also, position of  gnomes to the right or left influences the harvest of mushrooms produced. Have fun while at it.
